# Invariant AI

> Source-linked U.S. data for properties, infrastructure, energy and the physical economy.

Use Invariant Earth to query data at a coordinate or for the parcel that contains it. Check the field catalog for coverage and cite source URLs and data vintages when available.

Research downloads cover dated examples. For a site decision, review the current property and utility records. Power-flow studies describe modeled scenarios. Confirm service terms and available MW for the proposed phase with the serving utility.

## Connect to Invariant Earth

- [API quickstart and first query](https://docs.invariant-ai.com/quickstart.md)
- [Get an API key](https://docs.invariant-ai.com/get-api-key)
- [Invariant Earth MCP server](https://invariant-ai.com/mcp.md)
- [MCP installation for coding agents](https://docs.invariant-ai.com/mcp/installation.md)
- [POST /v1/geocode to geocode a u.s. address](https://docs.invariant-ai.com/api/geocode.md)
- [POST /v1/fetch to get fields for a coordinate](https://docs.invariant-ai.com/api/fetch.md)
- [POST /v1/enrich to get records for a parcel](https://docs.invariant-ai.com/api/enrich.md)
- [POST /v1/proximity to measure drive times and access](https://docs.invariant-ai.com/api/proximity.md)
- [Response statuses, source URLs and data vintages](https://docs.invariant-ai.com/responses.md)
- [Coverage and workflow examples](https://invariant-ai.com/data-coverage.md)
- [Live point field catalog](https://api.invariant-ai.com/v1/meta/fields)
- [Live parcel fields and presets](https://api.invariant-ai.com/v1/enrich/fields)
- [Request a data field](https://docs.invariant-ai.com/api/field-requests.md)
- [Download the versioned Python parcel and flood trial](https://github.com/in-variant/invariant-website/releases/tag/earth-gis-trial-v1.0.0)
- [Full API documentation index](https://docs.invariant-ai.com/llms.txt)
